leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Apply the `Partial<T>` utility type to create flexible form interfaces.
Construct read-only data structures using the `Readonly<T>` utility type.
Implement the `Pick<T, K>` utility type to extract specific properties from an interface.
Manipulate object types by omitting properties with the `Omit<T, K>` utility type.
Integrate the `Record<K, T>` utility type to define typed dictionaries or maps.
Update existing types by making properties optional or required with `Partial<T>` and `Required<T>`.
Configure component inputs using utility types to enforce type safety in Angular templates.
